name: deadline-duration
why: deadline given as a duration (300) instead of epoch ms: the run is past it before it starts

name: signal-timeout
why: AbortSignal.timeout instead of a deadline: the read rejects instead of answering

name: only-returned-keys
why: envelope from analytics' answer only: a track with no data is failed ('late'), not 'none'

name: hide-after-read
why: streams read for every viewer, then hidden from those without permission

name: no-restriction
why: readable alone, no restriction: an unreadable loader never touches the cache

name: skip-provider
why: another design: a viewer without permission is not asked for trackStreams at all
